regions.today: Dry with sunny spells in south Leinster, with showers clearing from northern parts this evening. Moderate northwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Becoming mainly dry tonight in all areas with clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Dry for much of tomorrow with a few sunny spells early in the day and cloud increasing later. Becoming breezy in the evening with outbreaks of rain or drizzle pushing in from the west. Highest temperatures of 19 to 21 degrees. Light to moderate southwest winds strengthening fresh later.
